methods.cost: subtract fixed additional 0.30 and 0.60 USD from every resolved Challenger trade
methods.month_block_bootstrap: resample complete Challenger exit-month PnL blocks with replacement, same number of months, 2000 iterations
methods.matched_random: from all causal sub-P90 wave-state transition onsets, sample exact accepted-candidate counts by entry month and chosen_side; apply same exact M1 and V19-priority portfolio; 2000 iterations
methods.pseudo_wave: within each fixed forward period circularly shift the complete wave_state sequence by a random nonzero offset of at least 32 decision rows, then rebuild event onsets with E40 and times unchanged; 2000 iterations
methods.leave_one_scale_out: recompute aggregate wave_state six times, omitting exactly one preregistered scale and renormalizing remaining fixed weights
methods.wave_only: same target wave-state event onset and chosen_side, without chosen_rank threshold
methods.e40_only: first causal transition into chosen_rank < P90 for the chosen_side, without wave-state condition
methods.interaction: fixed rank< P90 AND target wave state condition
methods.v19_overlap: raw Challenger event onset equal to a V19 entry or inside a frozen V19 open interval
methods.preempt_counterfactual: main policy closes Challenger only at actual V19 arrival; fixed comparison keeps Challenger and suppresses that V19 entry; comparison cannot change policy
methods.execution_dual: Numba/indexed implementation versus one-trade-at-a-time simple loop; entry index, exit index, reason and pnl exact
